title: Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.38220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch. We present Rubricon, a pipeline that generates discriminative rubrics without requiring human preference labels, rubric annotation, or generator-model training. Using any LLM, Rubricon samples multiple rubrics, selects the most discriminative candidate, adds criteria to capture overlooked requirements or response flaws, and prunes criteria that are misaligned or shallow. Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement. Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubri

translated_title: Rubricon：面向大语言模型评估与训练的自动化评分标准生成与精炼
translated_abstract: 评分标准能够在没有可验证答案的任务上实现奖励分配，但从头开始手动制作成本高昂。我们提出了Rubricon，这是一个无需人工偏好标签、评分标准标注或生成器模型训练即可生成具有区分性评分标准的流水线。利用任意大语言模型，Rubricon会采样多个评分标准，选出最具区分性的候选方案，添加标准以捕获被忽视的要求或响应缺陷，并修剪不对齐或流于表面的标准。结合大语言模型自我批评和测试时扩展，Rubricon利用在示例模型响应上观察到的标准通过率来指导精炼过程。在五个涵盖专业、消费级、临床和通用场景的大语言模型基准测试中，与RRD、QSRG、OpenRubrics等最佳替代性合成评分标准生成方法相比，Rubricon生成的评分标准在对前沿大语言模型响应的评分上，与劳动密集型的专家编写评分标准展现出高出9%的一致性。
tldr: Rubricon提出了一种无需人工标注或模型训练的自动化评分标准生成与精炼流水线，其生成的评分标准与专家编写标准的一致性比现有最佳合成方法高出9%。
en_tdlr: Rubricon is an automated pipeline that generates and refines discriminative rubrics without human labels or model training, achieving 9% greater alignment with expert-authored rubrics than the best alternative synthetic rubric generation methods.
